$comment: CENTRAL, IMMUTABLE standards-registry seed for the ISO/IEC 4200x AI-management family (Phase 7 / User Story 5 — Demonstrate Compliance and Audit Readiness / FR-051, FR-055, SC-012, SC-022). Each entry is a versioned StandardPublication fact loaded at the platform scope (tenant_id NULL) by packages/application/src/standards-import.ts and shaped by makeStandardPublication in packages/domain/src/compliance.ts. Fields are aligned column-for-column with db/migrations/0050_compliance.sql standard_publication / clause_version and with the governance-api StandardPublication schema (id, publisher, identifier, exact_title, edition, publication_date [ISO YYYY-MM-DD], status, material_type, source_uri, registry_version). material_type records the PUBLISHER's own classification of the document: 42001 states requirements, 42005 is guidance, and 42006 carries certification_body_criteria — which the domain's publicationDutyClass reclassifies as an audit-readiness input for an ordinary tenant and only as a directly-applicable obligation when the tenant is itself accredited as a certification body (FR-055). These are the publication FACTS (title/edition/date/publisher/URI) as recorded by ISO; they are NOT an assertion that any tenant conforms to, is accredited under, or is certified against any of them.
